outline:
此課程旨在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。使學生具備了解並建構決策問題，建構並推估決策之不確定性，以及建構並評估效用模式之能力。

This course is intended to provide students with the ability to:
1. Bring engineering principals to bear on decision making
2. Appreciate the challenges we face when making decisions, particularly decisions that must be made in the face of uncertainty
3.  Make better decisions in their personal and professional lives
4.  Play an active role in helping their employers and society make better decisions
 Communicate their choices and recommendations clearly
schedule:
I. Key philosophical concepts, Socratic instruction
II. Excel for Operations Issues (model design and solving)
III. Information gathering opportunities in terms of a value measure
IV. Specification of preference and Development of alternatives
assessment:
Attendance and participation: 30%
Homework: 30%
Project report: 40%
